author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam examines the hero costume of Homelander from The Boys! With the final season just recently completed, costumes and props from the series have been collected for fans in an upcoming Propstore auction. Adam takes a look at this iconic costume from the show and some of the standout pieces saved from the set. 

Learn more about these costumes and The Boys auction at https://propstore.com/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
